in_sanskrit.name: मानेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मानत् (manat) - to think, to consider, to reflect श (sha) - Lord, God Therefore, Mangesh means 'Lord of Thoughts' or 'God of Wisdom and Knowledge'

in_hindi.name: मानेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज्ञान (jñāna) - Knowledge पूर्ण (pūrṇa) - Full Therefore, Mangesh in Hindi means 'Full of Knowledge' or 'God of Wisdom'

in_tamil.name: மானேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜ்ஞானம் (jñānam) - Knowledge பெற்றவர் (perṟavar) - Possessor Therefore, Mangesh in Tamil means 'Possessor of Knowledge'

in_telugu.name: మానేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జ్ఞాన (jñāna) - Knowledge పూర్ణ (pūrṇa) - Full Therefore, Mangesh in Telugu means 'Full of Knowledge' or 'God of Wisdom'

in_marathi.name: Mangesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mangesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mangesh is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'God of Strength'. In Hindu mythology, Mangesh is a form of Lord Shiva, representing power and might. He is often depicted as having multiple arms, each holding a weapon or a symbol of destruction. Mangesh is worshipped for strength, courage, and protection from evil.
